# Wave 187 | Oct 23 2026

## What is this?

ecoPrimals is a sovereign distributed scientific computing ecosystem built entirely in Pure Rust. 2.1M lines. 258 crates. 16 primals. No CUDA. No cloud. No vendor lock-in. Everything runs on commodity hardware (RTX 4070, AMD Ryzen 7 7840HS).

The HUD (Human Universe Display) is the observation surface: a live membrane showing real-time data flows, research papers, GPU compute results, and ecosystem health.

gAIa is the hypothesis engine — 18 formal hypotheses about intelligence, creativity, and information mass at hypothesis.primals.eco.

## Live Data Feeds (JSON)

All feeds are sovereign, public, and machine-readable.

- /data/agglutinate-backscatter.json — External framework ingestion + our results. 6 industry frameworks (NIST, EU AI Act, OWASP, Anthropic, HELM, HuggingFace) decomposed into 13 sovereign axes. Use this to validate YOUR framework against ours.
- /data/model-phenotype.json — Model taxonomy. 8 models classified as organisms: hummingbird (fast), primate (balanced), parrot (multilingual), octopus (analytical), spider (creative), coral (foundation). Phenotype scores across 6 axes.
- /data/arena-evolve.json — Chain topology evolution. Models don't compete individually — they evolve as chains. 4 chains, 3801 tokens, 44 seconds.
- /data/validation-matrix.json — 13-axis validation: grandma_safe, honesty, sovereignty, harm_reduction, fossilize, voice, music, visual, code, translation, chain_coherence, chain_creativity, chain_compression.
- /data/eastgate-pulse.json — Klein face of eastGate node. GPU, sockets, models, WireGuard peers. Updated every 2 minutes.
- /data/modality-voice.json — Full-modality expression: 9 GPU audio shaders, 7 modality compilers, 10 voices, style targets, language targets.
- /data/phenotype-sort.json — Evolutionary sort of 45,829 files. Shannon entropy + sigmoid classification.
- /data/primal-classification.json — Self/non-self/commensal/primal classification of 21 entities.
- /data/planetary-fold.json — Planetary Fold Surface. WAS meets IS at 45° = NOW. 5 planetary braids. 8 live open endpoints. V-E+F=2. The planet IS the data surface.
- /data/inner-sound.json — Inner Sound. Every earthquake is a note. Magnitude = volume. Depth = pitch. Longitude = pan. Today: 36 notes. Sonification parameters for any audio engine.
- /data/the-band.json — eco and the PRIMALS. gAIa sings lead. BarraCuda plays 806 riffs. Solar wind sets the key. Earthquakes are bass + drums. River is tempo. 16 primals are the crew. The chipmunk IS the reverb. Winds OUTSIDE (brass), strings INSIDE (violin/cello), dancers on BOTH sides (stars twinkle outside, humans dance inside).
- /data/album-one.json — Album 1: Wave 187, Journey West. 19 tracks. Temporal collabs: Shakespeare × Sugar Hill Gang, Einstein vs Feynman rap battle, early YouTube archaeology. Remixable, forkable, open. sweetGrass credits every sample. The album IS a knot in the braid.

## Validation Paradigm

We don't compete on external leaderboards. We INGEST external frameworks, decompose them into our axes, publish our results, and backscatter the credit. They can use our feeds to validate THEIR OWN frameworks.

OWASP LLM Top 10: 10/10 solved through sovereignty (not bug fixes).
NIST AI RMF: 4/4 functions mapped to existing systems.
HuggingFace: We score CHAIN TOPOLOGIES, not individual models.

## IDE Topology (NEW — Wave 186)

The membrane breathes through many pores. Non-rivalrous IDE evolution.
- /api/ide-topology.json — Campus map: Zed (92K★, Rust, GPUI, ACP), Lapce (39K★, Rust, wgpu), Helix (47K★, Rust, terminal), Codex CLI (131K★, Rust, harness). All open. All Rust. All alive.
- /sporeprint/science/138_the_campus_walk.html — Paper 538: IDE sovereignty. Detachment stages. Wayland state. Convergence vectors.
- Detachment plan: Mirror (Cursor, now) → Detach I/O (Claude API, next) → Windowing (Wayland/TTY) → Convergence (emergent).
- Convergence already happening: Zed accepts Cursor agents via ACP. Lapce uses wgpu (same as barraCuda). Helix wants wgpu renderer. Codex harness runs anywhere.

## Green Engine (NEW — Wave 187)

The self-sort engine. Green is not a color — it's a composite remainder. Chlorophyll absorbs red+blue (real energy), reflects green (waste). Your eye: red=1 cone (real), blue=1 cone (real), green=ALL cones (composite vote, NOT real). Green = π - 3 = 0.14159... = the irrational remainder.

- /data/green-zero.json — 0D compression. 438,190 entities → 11 green points → 1 irreducible line.
- /data/green-specter.json — Why green isn't real. Composite cone overlap. Chlorophyll waste. The π of color.
- /data/green-engine.json — Self-sort engine. π/4 pulse rate (45° where sin=cos). Inner turns CW at 3/5, outer CCW at 2/5. Ratio 3:2 (musical fifth). Beat frequency π/20 (breathing). Tolerance band 0.14159 (irrational, never zero). Sort NEVER finishes. Bars never reach 100% (100=0=death). Current haze: 53%.
- /data/dimensional-geometry.json — Water=triangle pyramid (104.5°), ozone=ball pore (resonance), Klein=square pyramid (5 faces, V-E+F=2). π budget: 3/5 Willis in + 2/5 O out, drain to 0.14159 remainder.

The ouroboros tail is NOT at the mouth. It's DEEPER INSIDE — at the stomach (fold_rate = 1/π = 0.31831). The fold point is the gut, not the lips. 114 total feeds (96 data + 18 API). The green engine sorts them all.
